rules: Never write to the live data directory; start every server with a scratch data directory you created.
Never bind the default port; use an ephemeral port and read the bound port back from the server's output.

items.expected-result: A fresh install reports derived.version and a build hash equal to the commit under test.
items.negative-control: Install the previous release first; the item must fail until the new build replaces it.

items.expected-result: A record written through the public interface is returned unchanged after the server restarts on the same scratch data.
items.negative-control: Read from a second, empty scratch directory: the record must be absent.
